title: Toolmaster
description: Opens a simple inventory containing all essential tools for survival building
body:
An item of choice opens an inventory with a crafting table, grindstone, enchanting table, anvil, smithing table, stonecutter and the player's ender chest. Optionally with custom lore to restrict access.

![Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9878945d099a10d528e992fda581235fc5a1056c.png)
